entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Did you find any of
the
treasures
of ruin?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_01

entries.text: I hope you will investigate the shrines if you are\nat all inclined to do so.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_02

entries.text: Hm? It seems to me that you don’t have anything\nnew to report on the treasures of ruin...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_03

entries.text: Oh! You caught Ting-Lu, the Vessel of Ruin?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_04a

entries.text: Oh! You caught Chien-Pao, the Sword of Ruin?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_04b

entries.text: Oh! You caught Wo-Chien, the Tablets of Ruin?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_04c

entries.text: Oh! You caught Chi-Yu, the Beads of Ruin?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_04d

entries.text: Ohohooo! How interesting! I simply cannot keep\nmy curiosity under control![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_05

entries.text: Judging by its shape and size, this vessel was\nalmost certainly NOT for everyday use.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_06a

entries.text: Perhaps it was a work of art? Or, better yet, a\nritual artifact housing some sort of deity?![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_07a

entries.text: I feel that there must be some meaning behind\nthe horns and the designs resembling eyes.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_08a

entries.text: Could it be that this artifact was fashioned after\nthe deity’s very appearance?![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_09a

entries.text: So the sword’s blade and hilt form the Pokémon’s\nleft and right fangs![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_06b

entries.text: I wonder if the sword broke when it became a\nPokémon... Or perhaps it was always that way?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_07b

entries.text: No, wait—I cannot imagine the king wanting to\nbuy a broken sword.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_08b

entries.text: Maybe it was some sort of weapon that was\nmeant to be used in this “broken” state?![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_09b

entries.text: I’ve never seen so many wooden writing tablets\nstrung together! It must have been an epic tale![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_06c

entries.text: Most excavated tablets are tantamount to graffiti\nor simple memos—still valuable tools for learning\r\nabout the past, but nothing like this![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_07c

entries.text: I can’t read it, but given the length...it must be\na story, yes! Or perhaps the words of a curse...?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_08c

entries.text: If only the words weren’t faded! How frustrating!\nThese wooden tablets piqued the curiosity of a\r\nking! What might have been written on them?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_09c

entries.text: Beads like these were thought to be sacred and\nthus were worn during religious rituals.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_06d

entries.text: I believe they were most often worn as a single\nbead on the neck like a pendant, but it seems\r\nChi-Yu has four of them.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_07d

entries.text: Were the beads worn in pairs, like on the ears\nand wrists? Or were the rituals perhaps\r\nperformed by four people?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_08d

entries.text: What on earth could have caused beads such as\nthese—originally used to ward off disaster—to\r\nbecome bringers of disaster themselves?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_09d

entries.text: This mystery grows ever deeper. Ah! My thirst\nfor knowledge is slowly being quenched![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_10

entries.text: Hm? You look like you have something more to\nreport. What is it?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_11

entries.text: Seeing part of history with my own eyes fills me\nwith joy. I thank you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_12

entries.text: Please come back and report to me again if you\nfind more of the treasures of ruin.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_13

entries.text: This is simply amazing. You have now reported\nback to me with all four of the treasures of ruin.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_14

entries.text: I never thought that you would be able to do\nTHIS much for me.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_15

entries.text: You have my thanks, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_16

entries.text: I would have liked to go looking for the treasures\nof ruin myself and make them my own.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_17

entries.text: But I suppose it was precisely because I sent\nyou—someone with a pure heart—that we were\r\nable to accomplish this feat.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_18

entries.text: They may be the treasures of my dreams, but I\nwill allow you to have them for now.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_19

entries.text: Consider this a symbol of my gratitude, too.\nTake it. It is yours.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_20

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Heh. You truly are an interesting one, aren’t
you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]? I hope you
don’t
mind
if
I
continue
to
keep an eye on you![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_21

entries.text: You formed a close bond with Ms. Raifort!
entries.label: kizuna_history_d_system_01
